name: Midea VRF splits
tagline: One Mini VRF outdoor unit running up to six wall mounted indoor units.
summary: The Midea MDV-V235WN1(AU)-R Mini VRF connects one outdoor unit to as many as six wall mounted indoor units through a branch box, freeing up space outside.
It provides 20.0 kW of cooling and 23.5 kW of heating, with flare connections throughout for simpler installation.

image.alt: Midea VRF splits outdoor unit with connected indoor units

highlights.title: One to six rooms
highlights.text: A single outdoor unit supports one to six indoor units through a branch box.

highlights.title: All flare connections
highlights.text: Flare joints replace welding, which simplifies installation and lowers its cost.

highlights.title: Full DC inverter
highlights.text: The DC inverter compressor and fan motor adjust speed steplessly for efficient, consistent, quieter running.

highlights.title: Quiet and turbo modes
highlights.text: Quiet mode for low-noise comfort, and turbo mode for rapid cooling or heating.

highlights.title: Leak detection
highlights.text: A refrigerant leak detection system, plus auto restart after power interruptions.

highlights.title: 24-hour timer
highlights.text: A programmable 24-hour timer and a high-density air filter are included.

specs.label: Indoor units
specs.value: Up to 6 wall mounted, 1.5 to 8 kW each
